summary: Teaches connecting an Azure subscription to Grafana Cloud using a service principal and serverless Azure Metrics.

needs.description: Azure account able to create a service principal and assign roles, Azure CLI installed, and running Azure resources.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Azure account, Azure CLI, resources

needs.description: Admin basic role, or Azure Writer Cloud Provider role plus alerting/folder fixed roles.
Cloud Provider app Azure section with serverless Azure Metrics available.
Valid service principal credentials; guide types placeholders (client id 12345678-..., secret your-secret-password) that real validation would reject.
Azure Monitor metrics flowing so Services tab shows data.

reviewNotes: Placeholder credentials mean real E2E needs a real Azure subscription or a pre-created credential on the stack.
